import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = 1L << 60;
    static long[][] comb = new long[61][61];
    static int R, C;
    static String S;
    static List<long[]>[] dpL = new List[31];
    static List<long[]>[] dpR = new List[31];
    static long ans = 0;
    static long res = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        S = br.readLine();

        // Initialize combinations
        comb[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 61; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j];
                if (j > 0) comb[i][j] += comb[i-1][j-1];
            }
        }

        // Initialize dp arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
            dpL[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            dpR[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        dfsL(0, R-1, R-1, 0, 0);
        dfsR(0, R+C, R+C, 0, 0);

        long dif = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i <= R+C; i++) {
            Collections.sort(dpL[i], (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            Collections.sort(dpR[i], (a, b) -> Long.compare(b[0], a[0]));
            int ind = 0;
            for (long[] t : dpL[i]) {
                while (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size() && t[0] + dpR[i].get(ind+1)[0] >= 0) ind++;
                dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t[0] + dpR[i].get(ind)[0]));
                if (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size()) dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t[0] + dpR[i].get(ind+1)[0]));
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= R+C; i++) {
            List<long[]> z = new ArrayList<>();
            for (long[] t : dpR[i]) {
                if (ok(reverseMask((int)t[1], C+1))) {
                    z.add(t);
                }
            }
            int ind = 0;
            int l = 0, r = -1;
            for (long[] t : dpL[i]) {
                while (l < z.size() && t[0] + z.get(l)[0] > dif) l++;
                while (r + 1 < z.size() && t[0] + z.get(r+1)[0] >= -dif) r++;
                if (l <= r) {
                    check(t[0] | (reverseMask((int)z.get(l)[1], C+1) << (C+1)), r - l + 1);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void dfsL(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpL[a].add(new long[]{p, mask});
            return;
        }
        dfsL(ind + 1, a + 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), 
             p + (comb[a+1][R] - comb[a][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsL(ind + 1, a, b + 1, mask,
             p - (comb[b+1][R] - comb[b][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static void dfsR(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpR[a].add(new long[]{p, mask});
            return;
        }
        dfsR(ind + 1, a - 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind),
             p + (comb[a][R] - comb[a-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsR(ind + 1, a, b - 1, mask,
             p - (comb[b][R] - comb[b-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static long reverseMask(int x, int y) {
        int z = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            if ((x & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                z ^= 1 << (y - 1 - i);
            }
        }
        return z;
    }

    static boolean ok(int x) {
        for (int i = 0; i < C + 1; i++) {
            if ((x & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'B') return false;
            } else {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'A') return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void check(long x, int t) {
        res++;
        long tmp = 0;
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * C + 2; i++) {
            if ((x & (1L << i)) != 0) a++;
            else b++;
            if (a > 0 && b > 0) {
                for (int j = i; j < 2 * C + 2; j++) {
                    if ((x & (1L << j)) != 0) {
                        if (S.charAt(S.length() - (2 * C + 2) + j) == 'B') return;
                    } else {
                        if (S.charAt(S.length() - (2 * C + 2) + j) == 'A') return;
                    }
                }
                int aa = 0, bb = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < S.length() - (2 * C + 2) + i; j++) {
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'A') aa++;
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'B') bb++;
                }
                if ((x & (1L << i)) != 0) {
                    tmp = comb[R - 1 - aa + b + R - 1 - bb][R - 1 - aa];
                } else {
                    tmp = comb[a + R - 1 - aa + R - 1 - bb][a + R - 1 - aa];
                }
                ans += t * tmp;
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}
